prior_art: Alternating forms over F3 and quantum-switch phase readout are standard. This is a bounded design/testing reduction, not a new quantum-information primitive.

alternating_form_count.proof: Pfaffian=a f-b e+c d. For (a,b,c)=0, all 27 (f,-e,d) vanish in dot; for each of 26 other vectors there are 9 zero-dot choices: 27+26*9=261.

finite_shot_conservative_planning.scope: 99% worst-case bound assumes independent +-1 quadrature samples, known basis labels, v>=0.8 and drift<=0.1 for each setting; it does not certify that physical black-box gates obey the Weyl product law.

adversarial_holdout.invalid_assumption: Six settings identify an alternating bilinear form only under an independently tested Weyl/address linearity promise. Nonlinear word-dependent devices can fake all six.

physical_boundary: A six-parameter alternating form is not a dynamical TOE; its standard nondegenerate realizations are all isomorphic under GL4(F3). Physical gate address linearity and nonclassical order certification need additional measurements.
